args.dialogue: [uneasy] I don't know what to say.
[earnest] Say that you love me. [hopeful] That you understand.
[suspicious] But I don't understand. [disbelieving] You hear voices? [tense] Voices that tell you what to do?
[measured] I know how it sounds.
[firm] It sounds insane, Marcus. [disbelieving] Like clinically insane.
[earnest] I promise you I am the same person I've always been.
[dry] That's not the reassurance you think it is.
[firm] You were the one who told me to open up.
[measured] I meant about your day. Your childhood. Something normal.
[firm] This is my normal, June.
[uneasy] I just... I need some time to think.
[dry half to himself taking in the marble] Nice hotel for a murder.
[low even a partner not a cheerleader] Hey. Sorry to pull you in on date night.
[clipped shutting the door on the night] Forget it. [direct] What do we got?

[grounded reading from notes no lift] Victim is Jessica Vance. Twenty-six. [forensic neutral] Blunt force trauma back of the skull. [flat gesture to the floor] Found here in the lobby approximately an hour ago.
[focused] You got a murder weapon?
[matter-of-fact] Marble bookend. [procedural] Techs already bagged it.
[scanning the lobby almost rhetorical] Was she a guest here?
[quiet correction then giving him the better detail] Nope. According to staff she'd been turning up to the hotel repeatedly over the past few days. [low emphasis] Multiple incidents.
[floating a theory casual testing] She was an escort.
[flat understated] Nope. A stalker.
[sharper the case opening up] Stalker. [beat] Who was she stalking?
[concise no flourish on the follower count just fact] Autumn Tate. Lifestyle influencer. [beat] Four million followers. [grounding it] She's been staying here all week.
[quiet watching him work knows the look] Hey. Anything going on in that head of yours?
[thinking out loud slow deliberate] If stalking was the problem... [pause as the piece clicks into place] maybe murder was the solution.
[warm] Detective Song. Good to see you on scene.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Detective Song. Good to see you on scene.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] Marcus. [thoughtful] I had a feeling this one would find its way to you.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Marcus. I had a feeling this one would find its way to you.</line>

args.dialogue: [firm] Cassandra. [measured] What do you have for us?

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>KENT</speaker>Cassandra. What do you have for us?</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] Cause of death: blunt force trauma to the posterior skull. [firm] Time of death falls between ten-thirty and eleven PM. [dry] She did not linger.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Cause of death: blunt force trauma to the posterior skull. Time of death falls between ten-thirty and eleven PM. She did not linger.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] There is also something worth noting about the victim's coat. [thoughtful] One button misaligned — not consistent with how she was photographed entering the hotel earlier that evening. [measured] As if the coat was disturbed and imperfectly resettled.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>There is also something worth noting about the victim's coat. One button misaligned — not consistent with how she was photographed entering the hotel earlier that evening. As if the coat was disturbed and imperfectly resettled.</line>

args.dialogue: [curious] What does that tell us about the killer? [measured] Are we looking at a struggle, or someone who dressed her after?

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>SONG</speaker>What does that tell us about the killer? Are we looking at a struggle, or someone who dressed her after?</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] I need more time with the body before I commit to either reading. [thoughtful] The evidence is suggestive. It is not yet conclusive.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>I need more time with the body before I commit to either reading. The evidence is suggestive. It is not yet conclusive.</line>

args.text: The second character whispers about technology loudly.

script.source_xml: <audience_whisper>The second character whispers about technology loudly.</audience_whisper>

args.dialogue: [thoughtful] You know what keeps circling in my mind, Cassandra? [measured] The second character — they whisper about technology, loudly. [firm] Nathan is a social media manager. He documents everything. His whole world runs on what gets recorded and what doesn't.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_POV"><speaker>KENT</speaker>You know what keeps circling in my mind, Cassandra? The second character — they whisper about technology, loudly. Nathan is a social media manager. He documents everything. His whole world runs on what gets recorded and what doesn't.</line>

args.dialogue: [warm] I find that I enjoy listening to the way your mind moves, Marcus. [thoughtful] It takes its time arriving somewhere, but it rarely arrives wrong.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>I find that I enjoy listening to the way your mind moves, Marcus. It takes its time arriving somewhere, but it rarely arrives wrong.</line>

args.dialogue: [firm] The murder weapon — the bookend. What did you find on it?

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>The murder weapon — the bookend. What did you find on it?</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] Multiple sets of fingerprints. [firm] More than two.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Multiple sets of fingerprints. More than two.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] It was sitting on a public concierge desk. [dry] Half the lobby could have touched it.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>It was sitting on a public concierge desk. Half the lobby could have touched it.</line>

args.dialogue: [firm] Sure. [measured] But only one of them grabbed it and murdered Jessica.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_ExtremeCloseUp"><speaker>KENT</speaker>Sure. But only one of them grabbed it and murdered Jessica.</line>

args.dialogue: [thoughtful] I thought you were done for the night.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>KENT</speaker>I thought you were done for the night.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] I wanted to see the scene myself. [thoughtful] The body tells me one story. [suspicious] The room usually tells me another.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>I wanted to see the scene myself. The body tells me one story. The room usually tells me another.</line>

args.dialogue: [curious] And Song?

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>KENT</speaker>And Song?</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] She stepped out to take a call. [dry] I did not stop her.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>She stepped out to take a call. I did not stop her.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] So it's just us and the marble bookend.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_POV"><speaker>KENT</speaker>So it's just us and the marble bookend.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] Unless you'd prefer an audience. [thoughtful] I find I do my best thinking in smaller rooms.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Unless you'd prefer an audience. I find I do my best thinking in smaller rooms.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] You came back to the scene to think.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>KENT</speaker>You came back to the scene to think.</line>

args.dialogue: [angry] I came back because the concierge desk logs show the bookend was repositioned earlier that evening. [firm] It was not in its standard location at the time of the murder. [determined] Someone had already moved it once before it was used.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>I came back because the concierge desk logs show the bookend was repositioned earlier that evening. It was not in its standard location at the time of the murder. Someone had already moved it once before it was used.</line>

args.text: Say what you find interesting, but do it angrily.

script.source_xml: <audience_whisper>Say what you find interesting, but do it angrily.</audience_whisper>

args.dialogue: [angry] You want to know what I find interesting? [firm] That's not a crime of passion. [dry] That's a rehearsal. Someone walked up to that desk, moved the bookend, and then came back for it. [angry] That is not impulsive. [firm] That is a plan.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_ExtremeCloseUp"><speaker>KENT</speaker>You want to know what I find interesting? That's not a crime of passion. That's a rehearsal. Someone walked up to that desk, moved the bookend, and then came back for it. That is not impulsive. That is a plan.</line>

args.dialogue: [angry] Someone clumsy enough to leave a record of it.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Someone clumsy enough to leave a record of it.</line>

args.dialogue: [angry] Clumsy, or just too confident to think anyone would look.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_POV"><speaker>KENT</speaker>Clumsy, or just too confident to think anyone would look.</line>

args.dialogue: [angry] Those are the most interesting ones, Marcus. The ones who believe their own mythology.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>CASSANDRA</speaker>Those are the most interesting ones, Marcus. The ones who believe their own mythology.</line>

args.dialogue: [thoughtful] Richard was practically handing us a gift when we first sat down with him. [suspicious] Then the second we pressed on the details, the door closed.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>Richard was practically handing us a gift when we first sat down with him. Then the second we pressed on the details, the door closed.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] And every time it closed, he pointed us toward Nathan.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>KENT</speaker>And every time it closed, he pointed us toward Nathan.</line>

args.dialogue: [curious] So who do you think did it?

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>So who do you think did it?</line>

args.text: The second character tells the conversation should end soon quietly.

script.source_xml: <audience_whisper>The second character tells the conversation should end soon quietly.</audience_whisper>

args.dialogue: [thoughtful] Something's telling me this conversation should end soon — [determined] but I'll say it anyway. The voices are landing on Richard. The premeditation, the access, the way he pivoted the moment we got specific. He knows this hotel better than anyone in it.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_POV"><speaker>KENT</speaker>Something's telling me this conversation should end soon — but I'll say it anyway. The voices are landing on Richard. The premeditation, the access, the way he pivoted the moment we got specific. He knows this hotel better than anyone in it.</line>

args.dialogue: [firm] We're not done yet, though.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>SONG</speaker>We're not done yet, though.</line>

args.dialogue: [determined] Not even close.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>KENT</speaker>Not even close.</line>

args.dialogue: [determined] Then let's head back to the station. [measured] Lay it all out. [firm] Figure out what we still need.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>Then let's head back to the station. Lay it all out. Figure out what we still need.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] I'd like to talk to Autumn one more time before I do.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_CloseUp"><speaker>KENT</speaker>I'd like to talk to Autumn one more time before I do.</line>

args.dialogue: [measured] She was the target of the stalking and she's still in the building. [thoughtful] If Richard is our guy, she might be the only one who can tell us why Jessica scared him enough to act.

script.source_xml: <line shot="Character_Medium"><speaker>SONG</speaker>She was the target of the stalking and she's still in the building. If Richard is our guy, she might be the only one who can tell us why Jessica scared him enough to act.</line>
